body.name: Finite centered stratum union-envelope program
body.construction:
For each \(x\), let \(\ell_{\mathrm{PT}}(a)=(1,0,a^{\prime},0)^{\prime}\), \(\ell_{\mathrm{SC}}(d)=(0,1,0,d^{\prime})^{\prime}\), and \(c(a,d)=\ell_{\mathrm{PT}}(a)-\ell_{\mathrm{SC}}(d)\), where these vectors multiply the centered basis \(h_x=(g^{\circ}_{\mathrm{PT},x},g^{\circ}_{\mathrm{SC},x},R_{\mathrm{PT},x}^{\prime},R_{\mathrm{SC},x}^{\prime})^{\prime}\). Define \(\psi^{\circ}_{\mathrm{PT},x}(a)=g^{\circ}_{\mathrm{PT},x}+R_{\mathrm{PT},x}^{\prime}a\) and \(\psi^{\circ}_{\mathrm{SC},x}(d)=g^{\circ}_{\mathrm{SC},x}+R_{\mathrm{SC},x}^{\prime}d\). The program \(\mathrm{QP}_x\) minimizes
\[
 \ell_{\mathrm{PT}}(a)^{\prime}\Omega_x\ell_{\mathrm{PT}}(a)
 =E_O[\{\psi^{\circ}_{\mathrm{PT},x}(a)\}^2\mid X=x]
\]
over \(a\in\mathbb R^J\) and \(d\in\mathbb R^T\), subject to \(\Omega_x^{1/2}c(a,d)=0\); among tied pairs it selects the Euclidean minimum-norm pair \((a_x^U,d_x^U)\). The program is defined only on the centered basis and contains no treated-composition coordinate. The \(J\)-coordinate PT block has the known null direction \(\mathbf 1_J\).
